choice: Answer only Host 127.0.0.1 or localhost on our port (DNS rebinding). POST endpoints need the page's Origin or none, Content-Type application/json, and no Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site (CSRF). /api/open accepts only plain https://linear.app links. The page has a Content Security Policy and renders Linear text with textContent.
context: Any page open in the user's browser can send requests to 127.0.0.1.
rejected: The Host check alone (an earlier version): a cross-site no-cors POST could open any linear.app URL in the user's browser or exhaust the API key's rate limit through /api/refresh.
title: Harden the localhost server against other websites
